selection_policy: Latest numeric attempt per group/pair; pinned G0 source-contract credit; marker-bound latest motion single-call attempt. Failed raw receipts remain indexed. PASS needs a completed receipt, actual end marker, Verilog Pass report, complete expected transaction count and required post-run hash receipts. Preparation/C preprocessing is not RTL PASS.
scope_notes: Frozen public production C++; no local algorithm/ROI improvement was used.
Motion full-size C covers alpha0/30/50 and rejection invariants. Selected RTL family is separate cold/warm alpha50 single calls; original four-call alpha0 plan is not completed.
Temporal bounded AXI depth15360;70 synthesized HDL files byte-equal to production. Production aperture122880000 and uninterrupted11-call behavior remain unvalidated.
Copy requires G0 and P2..P10,C audits,source contract and post hashes. Failed G1 or12-call progress receives no partial RTL credit.
ROI requires all7 groups and full host-trace C audit; independent seeded groups do not prove uninterrupted9-call operation.
RTL vector coverage is not formal equivalence, physical timing closure or board acceptance.
Keep every HLS timing/II warning; resources and timing are estimates.
No VHDL functional verification; sealed VHDL differs in alpha50/FIFO handling.
